verified_provider_state: Run-08 LATEST.json recovered from GitHub main at 84c56429f5fe2139e3bdf9cbfa05b4c44f37ff67.

source_classification.inference: Immutable object identity alone is insufficient as a living verification state: without an observation time and revalidation deadline, a valid proof can silently become stale while still being presented as current.
source_classification.contradiction: Run-08 called provider and host state verified but encoded no freshness lease in the binding tuple; this made current verification semantically permanent even though both provider observation and host executable state can change.
source_classification.prior_assistant_interpretation: Run-08 correctly separated provider and host proof lanes, but freshness was deferred to its next frontier rather than enforced.

failure_pattern_attacked: Verified continuity proofs could remain trusted indefinitely after their observations or host executable became stale; provider manifest creation and host proof renewal also depended on manual reconstruction.
concrete_outputs: immutable external commit metadata binding using tree_sha and parent_shas
automated reversible host runtime proof refresher with guaranteed deactivation cleanup

five new v4 adversarial freshness/fingerprint tests
three proof-refresh tool tests including cleanup-on-failure

counterevidence: The broad unittest suite mutated an unrelated generated casebuilding receipt; that incidental artifact was reverted and excluded from the durable delta.
Provider-state v3 remains supported so validator code can land without invalidating the still-bound run-08 pointer during migration.
Host recommendation output is treated as non-critical enrichment; lifecycle verification depends on status/search/activate/readback/deactivate/restoration assertions, not recommendation availability.

objective_state_delta.before: Run-08 proof bindings established object identity but had no expiry/revalidation semantics; provider and host proof refresh were manual and the host proof was not bound to executable fingerprint freshness.
objective_state_delta.after: Provider-state v4 makes provider and host verification renewable leases: stale proofs fail closed offline, external commits carry immutable tree/parent identity, host proof is bound to the exact Skills executable SHA-256, and both proof lanes now have executable refresh tools with tested cleanup and revalidation behavior.

unresolved: Proof refresh tools update evidence files but do not yet atomically renew LATEST.json bindings; a refresh can therefore produce fresh evidence while the recovery pointer still names the prior digest until a separate binding step occurs.
Freshness deadlines are enforced at validation time but there is not yet a near-expiry warning/renewal transaction that refreshes both proof lanes and pointer bindings before CI crosses the deadline.
next_executable_frontier: Build an atomic proof-renewal transaction that refreshes provider and host evidence, validates both new receipts, updates only the renewable proof bindings in LATEST.json without changing the mission frontier/run sequence, preserves a renewal receipt with before/after digests, and fails safely if either lane cannot refresh; add near-expiry status and rollback tests so scheduled runs renew proof leases before CI reaches expiry.
